limits: Prepared fixtures and unchanged assertions/deadlines; no natural gameplay or user acceptance claim.
Both pending-transfer controls escape and refill on their first seven-step route. Natural inventory ACK settles after the real pending PICKUP at submersion and before AIR route admission.

Real stop drains the original actor and returns unworn shears to main20, with empty hotbar1/cursor, selected0 and exact input/native settings restoration. No wool, shearing or animal damage is observed.

Primary pending-attack witnesses LIVE slice expiry at log141 before all height messages, followed by attempt1/index3 retry at2191ms. Log146 then expires again before attempt2/index1 retry at3145ms; the deferred height message follows at148.
Deferred logging alone therefore does not resolve the timeout-to-retry seam. The exact native call consuming each observation budget is not identified.
The third native route later fails. AIR pauses and the player drowns; the original final screenshot directly shows the player death screen.
The cow health10 and output0 remain unchanged. The dead0 counter counts target deaths, not player deaths; final actor send count is absent.
No real stop occurs in the failed attack case because the unchanged verifier waits for successful AIR completion. Safe actor/hand cleanup after that failure is unproved.
Modern attack and both roof reruns remain unrun after the primary failure. Earlier passes remain evidence of their earlier exact artifacts.
Cooking drafts present during the attack launch were not compiled into the already frozen artifact or verifier outputs. Those outputs and both jars remain byte-identical during the run.

The complete118693-byte prior release body is preserved by exact public hash/byte read-back before shortening the index. Every prior790 asset remains;127 screenshot manifests are linked. Three new screenshots pass anonymous bytes/hash and logged-out decoding before six exact local copies are deleted.
Full native-path entity clearance remains unproved. New typed LIVE yield source is a separate later unit, absent from these artifacts.
